Regression builds remained frozen. Final attribution separators were corrected and compact Details controls separated; six final Explore visual/axe cases and three focused Details clearance/popup/directions cases passed. Final lint, assets and production builds passed.
Hosted checks use only the public publishable key. Actual public counts: seven categories, zero places/images. Private records remain hidden; no privileged draft count audit is implied.
Local PostgreSQL/PostGIS tests simulate platform Auth/Storage contracts. GPS/touch are browser emulation, not physical-device or live GPS accuracy certification.
